newsitem.title: USA: Clinton said encouraged on budget, no deal yet.
newsitem.headline: Clinton said encouraged on budget, no deal yet.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton is encouraged by progress in balanced-budget talks but there is no deal yet, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said on Thursday.

McCurry also told reporters at his daily briefing that budget talks might continue on Thursday night and could go into Friday, adding that budget negotiators were closing in on the "structure" of a possible deal but unresolved issues remained.

McCurry said Clinton may make calls on Thursday afternoon on the budget but was not currently expected to make any announcement on the budget on Thursday or to go to Capitol Hill to discuss the matter.
"He is encouraged by the progress that is being reported to him but at the same time there are some unresolved issues," McCurry said, adding much work remained to be done.
"That hard work will continue I would guess through the day and into the night and probably into tomorrow," he said.
"There is no done deal," the spokesman added. "Obviously they are closing in on the structure of something that looks like it might have some possibilities but there is a lot of hard work ahead."
